review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib for uses of Equiv.map, Equiv.traverse, Equiv.functor and Equiv.traversable. The only external use is Mathlib/Data/DList/Instances.lean:38, which applies Equiv.traversable directly. The file already packages the data as Functor, Traversable, LawfulFunctor and LawfulTraversable instances, so the transfer is already exposed through the standard structures. The lemmas id_map, comp_map, id_traverse, comp_traverse and naturality are the fields of those lawful classes. They are supplied through lawfulFunctor and isLawfulTraversable. I found no standard bundled structure that would add to this. Equiv.map and Equiv.traverse are families of functions over the type-constructor equivalence eqv, which is not a single Equiv. Mathlib has no bundled natural isomorphism of Type-valued functors that fits here. I did not check this against every category-theory file, so some uncertainty remains. The proposal to bundle them is speculative and has no practical use in this code.
